g.text: v3 policy holdout. Post-protocol descriptive oracle: fastest eligible PR-only exhaustive control per case.
All 308 cases per width are included; no CIs or tail clipping. Ratios above 1 favor radix PR.
Controls: comparison-sort sparse/direct dense, Klein, and radix direct/nearest dense; three-repeat whole-task medians.
